data.action: 扛着熔光大剑稳步前行
data.description: 【莱瓦汀 · 冰原行军】终末地工业开辟的极寒冰原之上，莱瓦汀单手扛着散发着耀眼熔岩赤芒的重型动力大剑，沉重的战靴在厚厚的坚冰上踩出阵阵白雾。她甩开火红色层次发束回眸露出狂放好战的笑容——「冰原的严寒根本不值一提！管理员，前方的侵蚀体巢穴已经锁定，看我一剑把它们全部烧成灰烬！」
data.lighting: pale ice light with warm sword glow
data.promptProse: Laevatain carries her greatsword on one shoulder and glances back at the viewer while striding across the ice. Its molten glow warms the edge of her hair against the pale frozen landscape.
data.title: 莱瓦汀 · 冰原行军
data.animaCaption: The greatsword rests on one shoulder as she looks back while striding across the ice.
